name: Desperate Prayer
summary: In Stormwind, promising priests from Elwynn Forest come for deeper training in the Church of the Holy Light. After proving their devotion and discipline, they present themselves to High Priestess Laurena at the Cathedral of Light.

sections.title: A Summons to the Capital
sections.body: Priestess Josetta guides novice priests in Goldshire, while local mentors serve Elwynn Forest's outlying settlements. When a disciple proves capable in spirit and deeds, word reaches Stormwind's senior priesthood. A summons to the Cathedral of Light marks a move to deeper duties in the faith and formal training at the spiritual heart of the Kingdom of Stormwind.

sections.title: Guidance from the High Priestess
sections.body: At the Cathedral, acolytes come before High Priestess Laurena, a senior leader of the Church in Stormwind. She oversees their spiritual grounding and practical training as newly elevated priests. Her instruction prepares them for the Alliance's harsh trials and teaches the Light's miracles, including Desperate Prayer, a plea for salvation known among human practitioners.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the quest Desperate Prayer?
faq.answer: Desperate Prayer sends promising priests from Goldshire to Stormwind's Cathedral of Light for further training under High Priestess Laurena.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Desperate Prayer?
faq.answer: Priestess Josetta, the priest trainer at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, gives you the summons after you prove your devotion.
High Priestess Laurena is a senior leader of the Church of the Holy Light who trains acolytes inside Stormwind's Cathedral of Light.

faq.q: Where is the Cathedral of Light located?
faq.answer: The Cathedral of Light is in Cathedral Square, in Stormwind City's northern district. It is the kingdom's spiritual center for priests and paladins.

faq.q: Why is the quest named Desperate Prayer?
faq.answer: Human priests learn Desperate Prayer in Stormwind as a plea to the Light for immediate, self-preserving deliverance.

faq.q: Do other races or classes get this quest?
aliases: can dwarves do desperate prayer quest
faq.answer: This instruction is for priests advancing from Elwynn Forest to begin higher training in Stormwind.

angles.text: As a priest, you move from novice service in Goldshire to training under the Cathedral of Light's senior leadership.
As a human who follows the Holy Light, entering the Cathedral of Light affirms your duty to the kingdom's spiritual heart.
As an Alliance member, you belong to a people bound in part by the Church of the Holy Light, one of its strongest cultural and moral pillars amid looming threats.
